title: Measured BI-RADS Concepts and Concept Leakage in Interpretable Breast Ultrasound Diagnosis: code and derived data
description: Code, summary statistics, and derived data (lesion lists, patient level splits, measured concept values, and MedSAM masks) for a study of concept bottleneck models for breast ultrasound supervised by BI-RADS aligned concepts measured on MedSAM segmentations, evaluated with leave one dataset out validation on five public datasets.
